title: VitaBench — Task Construction, Agent Loop, and Strict Scoring

nodes.label:
Three Core Life Service Domains
Food Delivery, In-store Dining, and OTA
Representative real-world lifestyle services

66 Stateful Service Tools
Explicit preconditions and postconditions
APIs for querying, reserving, ordering, paying

Tool Dependency Graphs
Formal directed dependency specifications
Enforces logical sequential tool calling order

Dynamic User Need Simulation
Progressively reveals hidden constraints
Simulates realistic customer conversation

Diverse User Personas
Demographics, dietary preferences, budget limits
Loyalty status and behavioral history

Composite Authentic Requests
Multi-objective real-world user queries
Cross-shop and multi-constraint requirements

Real & Synthetic Environment Data
Realistic merchant menus, room types, prices
Dynamic stock, wait times and coupons

Human-Authored Rubric Packages
Fine-grained satisfaction criteria per task
Objective boolean state checks

Compose Candidate Tasks
Synthesize initial task candidates
Bind user profile, query, environment, and rubric

Multi-Round Agent Trial Runs
Simulate multi-turn interaction loops
Verify task solvability and state coherence

Human Acceptance Gate
Human experts review trial transcript & state
Validate solvability and realistic constraints

Iterative Task & Rubric Revision
Refine underspecified prompts or rubrics
Patch mock environment data anomalies

Final 400 Curated Tasks
100 cross-domain + 300 single-domain tasks
Balanced: 100 Delivery, 100 In-store, 100 OTA

Candidate Agent Execution
Agent receives instructions and tool catalog
Conducts multi-turn conversational reasoning

Bilateral Interaction Simulation
User Simulator ↔ Agent ↔ Tool Environment
Stateful multi-party conversation exchange

Termination Condition Check
Detect ###STOP### token, max turns or error
Branch to evaluation or continue loop

Advance to Next Turn
Feed environment observation or user response
Continue autonomous multi-turn dialogue

Abrupt Failure Termination
Agent hits fatal exception or token limit
Log incomplete execution transcript

Complete Interaction Trajectory
Chronological sequence of thoughts, calls, states
Full conversation and tool payload history

Overlapping Trajectory Windows
Slice long-horizon trace into overlapping windows
Track progressive milestone accomplishment

Persistent Rubric State Tracking
Maintain bit vector s in {0,1}^k for k rubrics
Track cumulative satisfaction of all criteria

Strict All-Rubrics Compliance
Strict = 1[Sum s_j = k]
Requires 100% satisfaction of all criteria

Four Repeated Independent Runs
Re-run each task 4 times at temperature zero
Measure execution stability and variance

Average Accuracy Metric (Avg@4)
Mean strict success rate across 4 runs
General capability expectation

At-Least-Once Success (Pass@4)
Success if at least one of four runs succeeds
Measures upper-bound exploration capability

Full Consistency Reliability (Pass^4)
Success only if all four runs succeed
Strict enterprise-grade reliability benchmark
